### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

**Check <https://hacktricks-training.com/courses/lhe/> to learn tens of linux privesc techniques and master LinPEAS** Here you will find **privilege escalation tools for Windows and Linux/Unix\* and MacOS**. These tools search for possible **local privilege escalation paths** that you could exploit and print them to you **with nice colors** so you can recognize the misconfigurations easily. - Check the **Local Windows Privilege Escalation checklist** from **[book.hacktricks.wiki](https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/windows-hardening/checklist-windows-privilege-escalation.html)** - **[WinPEAS](https://github.com/peass-ng/PEASS-ng/tree/master/winPEAS) - Windows local Privilege Escalation Awesome S
